newsitem.title: USA: Time to do something about CPI bias - Fed's Rivlin.
newsitem.headline: Time to do something about CPI bias - Fed's Rivlin.

text.p: Federal Reserve Vice Chair Alice Rivlin on Thursday called for action to fix the consumer price index (CPI).
"I think we've studied the CPI," she told reporters after a speech to the National Community Reinvestment Coalition. "We need to do something about it at the moment."
White House spokesman Mike McCurry told reporters earlier that the idea of forming a bipartisan commission to determine possible changes to the CPI "has not been warmly received" in Congress.

Most economists agree that the CPI overstates inflation but there is no consensus on how to go about addressing the issue. The subject is politically sensitive because many popular federal benefits are indexed to the CPI.
